headline: Nevaeh speaks out and goes OFF about Blueface getting upset with her for streaming with N3
body: Nevaeh speaks out and goes OFF about Blueface getting upset with her for streaming with N3ON and going on vacation to Hawaii, but there’s a major part of the situation that people need to remember. Blueface was actually the one who refused to go on the family vacation in the first place. It wasn’t until N3ON stepped in and offered to make the trip happen that things started moving forward.

Nevaeh speaks out and goes OFF about #Blueface getting upset with her for streaming with N3ON and going on vacation to Hawaii, but there’s a major part of the situation that people need to remember.

Blueface was actually the one who refused to go on the family vacation in the first place. It wasn’t until #N3ON stepped in and offered to make the trip happen that things started moving forward.

Now, Blueface allegedly has an issue with her streaming with N3ON and enjoying a vacation that he initially didn’t even want to be a part of. 

Nevaeh isn’t holding back when it comes to explaining her side of the story, making it clear that she’s frustrated with how the situation is being turned around on her.
